rules.closeNextNote: Compress hit/rebound windows to fit before next onset; do not force neutral between close notes.
rules.eighthAndSixteenth: Use event-gap-aware hit/rebound; remain in flowing action sequence until phrase gap permits neutral.
rules.rapidSn: Use authoritative alternating L/R sidecar; each event transitions to its assigned hit/rebound without inserting neutral between rapid events.
rules.tomFill: Follow authoritative R/L sidecar and instrument order; no body/camera/stool jump between tom assets.
rules.simultaneous: One combo hit/rebound represents all simultaneous limbs; never serialize the simultaneous instruments.
rules.handPlusFoot: Hand and foot move within the same combo frame; stool and body registration remain locked.
rules.comboToCombo: Directly transition via rebound/next hit according to event gap; neutral only when gap is non-rapid and timing permits.
rules.cymbalToSnare: Preserve torso/camera; move only required arms/shoulders, honoring limb assignment.
rules.tomToTom: Keep seated base fixed and make consecutive stick/arm movements continuous.

forbidden: unnecessary neutral flash between close events

knownException.SN:R: Runtime rebound deliberately holds approved sn_r_hit because retained sn_r_rebound caused a visual jump; phase remains rebound.
